name: L_gated
description: vm-00007: vm-00005's L (one lifetime, CEM planner on the latent world model, a gradient step after every step from the newest 8 steps plus 7 replayed sequences), with a gated memory: a short-term buffer of the last 256 steps, and a long-term memory of 8-step chunks that enter it when they lead to hunger relief, when they were surprising (the model's prediction of the next frame and drives was unusually wrong), or by a draw. Arms set online.store_*; the defaults store everything (the uniform control).
